World positions relative to the unit, turned by its heading, are scaled by half width / range in x and by 0x00410A38 / range in y (+0x100). Draws, under its own scissor: the dark backing and frame, crosshair, range ticks and view cone; mission 16 sweep pulses at the units of list +0x80 (0x00168CD0); every shown unit as an icon (player white, by side and threat colour, heading cell for aircraft, marker for flagged units; alpha by distance for class bit 8); missiles and specials as dots (blinking, unless the state flag 0x08000000 or status flag 0x10000000 is set); the mission area border (rules +0x00 +-32768 with status flag 0x10000000, else +-rules +0x20) and, in some missions, the line z = rules +0x1C as a dashed sprite; the approach line (status flag 0x01000000) and mission 15's runways; then the HUD-coloured frame.

name: func_0016B7C8

name: DrawRadarMap

name: SelectHudWarning
